CEOs who have a more positive view of themselves and their abilities are more likely to engage in transformational leadership and to be rated as having a greater strategic influence, whereas CEOs with narcissistic tendencies are more likely to focus on transactional leadership and contingent rewards and to be rated lower on strategic influence.
